communication_goal: 礼貌提出建议，明确它是可选修改。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers sit beside a desktop monitor doing a friendly code review. The reviewer on the left has one hand on a computer mouse, the author on the right listens with a relaxed open-hand gesture. On the monitor, draw sparse abstract code-like horizontal marks and ONE large, sharply recognizable arrow-shaped mouse cursor over an empty gap near the middle-right. Cursor is a black outlined classic diagonal arrow with white interior, visually distinct from code marks and not touching them. Keep the cursor entirely visible and large enough for a local learning crop. No letters, readable code, or text.

image_review.summary: 通过：屏幕中的鼠标箭头光标与抽象代码短线清楚分开；评审者用鼠标指出位置，代码作者回应。光标可独立裁剪；建议、重命名及可选属性由对白说明，不以无文字代码声称完成真实修改。
